/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L3: description: Session 4 on 2023-05-01 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L16: Calvin: Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L20: Dave: Thanks, Cal! It's great to see my hard work paying off. Opening this shop was my dream, and I'm really happy to see it getting started. It was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L23: Calvin: Woo, Dave! Congrats on achieving your dream - you've got guts and ambition - that's awesome! Keep it up!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L27: Dave: Thanks! Appreciate the support. My dream was to open a shop and it's a step towards my other dream of working on classic cars. I love their design and engineering.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L34: Dave: I'm obsessed with classic cars. They have a unique charm. I was so thrilled to restore one last year—nothing like bringing it back to life! Take a look at the engine of the restored car.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L38: Calvin: Wow, Dave! That looks awesome!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L41: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It was a labor of love. Challenging, but so worth it.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L47: Dave: Yeah! It feels great to see the hard work pay off, it's like bringing something back to life.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L53: Dave: Yeah, Calvin! It's such an amazing feeling to see something you create become a reality. Knowing that your skills and hard work made it happen is incredible.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L56: Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Feels good when our hard work pays off. It's the perfect blend of dedication and passion!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L59: Dave: Yeah, that mix really keeps me motivated and makes it all worthwhile.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L65: Dave: I will! By the way, This is a photo of my shop. Come by sometime, if you can!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L72: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I work on all kinds of cars at the shop - from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It keeps me busy and happy!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L75: Calvin: Wow Dave, working on cars must be really rewarding.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L78: Dave: Definitely, working on cars is what I'm passionate about. Doing it every day is so rewarding! Seeing the transformation is awesome and knowing I'm helping people keep their cars in good condition is really satisfying.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L81: Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Doing something you love and helping others is so rewarding. Keep up the great work!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L84: Dave: Thanks, Cal! I really appreciate the boost. It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L87: Calvin: Glad to help, Dave! So awesome to see you doing your thing and making a difference. Your hard work and talent totally deserve all the recognition. Keep on keepin' on, bud! Take a look at this beautiful necklace with a diamond pendant, that's so stunning!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L91: Dave: Wow, that's a great necklace! Where did you get it?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L94: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I got it from another artist as a gift - it's a great reminder of why I keep hustling as a musician!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L97: Dave: Awesome, Calvin! Keep pushing and making music, it'll remind us why we keep hustling.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L100: Calvin: Yeah, Dave! The road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going. Let's keep each other motivated!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L3: description: Session 5 on 2023-05-03 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no talk. How's it going? Crazy news - I'm teaming up with a local garage. Take a look at what we working on together!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L16: Calvin: Hey Dave, great to hear from you! That's awesome news about teaming up with a local garage. Super inspiring seeing you follow your passion. Congratulations on this new venture. It's impressive how far you've come since we last chatted. How's everything going?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L20: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I'm loving this job. I get to work with awesome mechanics and share my knowledge about cars. Here's what I'm currently working on! It's a cool project, even if it's a bit challenging. 🤩
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L27: Dave: Thanks Calvin! Appreciate the support. I'm gonna keep learning more about auto engineering, maybe even build a custom car from scratch someday - that's the dream! For now, just gonna keep working on this project and assisting customers.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, Dave! You're so inspiring - good for you for pushing yourself to achieve your dream. Making a custom car sounds awesome. Don't forget to relax and enjoy the process too!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L33: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Gotta take time to chill. Do you have any hobbies that help you relax?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L36: Calvin: Hey Dave, long drives in [this car] really help me relax. The feeling of the wind and the open road is so freeing. It helps me clear my head. What do you like to do to chill out? 
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L40: Dave: Yeah, I hear you! Driving with the wind in your hair is so calming. Taking a walk around is a great way to destress, too. Exploring, taking in the sights and sounds - it's such a peaceful experience.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L46: Dave: If I'm having trouble coming up with ideas, I usually immerse myself in something I love, like concerts or my favorite albums. Doing that usually helps to jumpstart my inspiration. Maybe try taking a break from music and explore other things. Plus, have some fun while you're at it!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L49: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Taking a break is great for getting my mojo back. I'll definitely take your advice and explore. Appreciate the help! You're awesome!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L52: Dave: No worries, Calvin! Glad I could help. Keep pursuing your music and never give up. You're awesome! 🤘
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L58: Dave: Sure, Calvin! Keep in touch. If you ever need help, just let me know. Bye!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L3: description: Session 9 on 2023-06-21 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L12: Calvin: Hi Dave! Nice to hear from you. Since last chat, some things have happened. I had a lil car accident last Friday, kinda upsetting but no one was hurt. I've been dealing with insurance and repairs - taking up a lot of time and energy. Look at this photo!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L16: Dave: Sorry to hear about the car accident, Calvin. I'm glad to hear that nobody was hurt. Dealing with insurance and repairs can definitely be time-consuming and draining. Have you encountered any issues in the insurance process so far?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L19: Calvin: Hey Dave, thanks for checking in! The insurance process was a hassle - it took forever and there was a ton of paperwork. But it's all sorted now, and I'm getting it fixed up. Can't wait to drive it again!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L23: Dave: How long did it take to get everything sorted out? I'm glad it's all taken care of now!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L30: Dave: Cool! Glad it wasn't too expensive. Who are him?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L36: Dave: That's great to hear! Skilled and knowledgeable people working on your car - are you feeling confident?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L42: Dave: Great, Cal! It's awesome when you trust the people fixing it. Sounds like they're doing a great job. It'll be back to normal soon!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L45: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Excited to drive again. Appreciate your help! Look what a wonderful view from living room!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L49: Dave: Wow, what an amazing view! Where is it? I haven't seen anything like that before!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L52: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's from a small town in Japan. The view of the mountains is unbelievably stunning!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L55: Dave: Wow! Did you get to that place yet?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L62: Dave: Looks awesome! Have you ever tried skiing before? It looks like loads of fun!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L68: Dave: Yes, Cal! I recently joined a rock band and have been practicing guitar. Look at this photo – it's us, the guys! 
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L72: Calvin: Playing guitar in a rock band is awesome, Dave! It will bring you a lot of emotions.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L75: Dave: Sounds good, Calvin! Good company and great music, lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions! I have to go now. I'll see you soon!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L78: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! let's keep in touch, take care!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L3: description: Session 12 on 2023-08-03 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave, long time no see! I just took my Ferrari for a service and it was so stressful. I'm kinda attached to it. Can you relate? What kind of hobbies give you a feeling of being restored?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L15: Dave: Hey Calvin, I understand the stress of getting a car serviced. Fixing cars is like therapy for me. Growing up working on cars with my dad, refurbishing them gives me a sense of fulfillment.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L18: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! Must feel great to have a hobby that makes you proud. Remember any good memories from working on cars with your dad?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L21: Dave: Yeah, definitely! I have fond memories of working on cars with my dad as a kid. We spent one summer restoring an old car. It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L24: Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Working together on projects like that really brings people closer. Do you have any pictures from that time?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L27: Dave: Yes, I have one, take a look. It was a wonderful experience.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L31: Calvin: Aww, that's cool, Dave. Reminiscing is always fun! That pic you shared takes me back to my trip to the Ferrari dealership. I saw a lot of amazing cars, but as for me, my car is the best and  I'm pretty proud of this. Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication. It really inspires me. Take a look at this beauty!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L35: Dave: Your car looks great, Calvin! I can tell why you're proud. Having something like that is motivating. It's like a reminder of what you can achieve.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L38: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Seeing it everyday keeps me motivated and reminds me to keep pushing.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L41: Dave: Sounds like you're really motivated, Calvin. What's the biggest goal you're working towards, music-wise or something else?
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L48: Dave: Wow, Calvin! Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L51: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Your support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I'm determined to make my dreams come true.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L54: Dave: Glad to help, Calvin! Eager to see what you do. Keep at it and never forget your dreams!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L57: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I appreciate your support, it means a lot to me. I'll keep going for my dreams.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L60: Dave: No problem, Calvin! Just remember to stay focused and keep going. You've got this!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-12.md:L63: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'll stay focused and keep going. Appreciate your belief!
